request.state:
Icelandic original: „Flatey býður upp á kyrrð og ró, fallega fjallasýn á Flateyjarskaga, víðáttu og ilm af hafinu. Þar er alltaf gott veður. Færir mann aftur til fortíðar þar sem þurfti að hafa aðeins meira fyrir lífinu.“
English gloss: “Flatey offers quiet and peace, beautiful mountain views on the Flateyjarskagi, wide horizons and the scent of the sea. The weather is always good there. Returning there takes one back to the past, where one might need only a little more for life.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
